تفاخرت (form VI)
# تَفَاخَرْتُ (tafāḵartu) /ta.faː.xar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
# تَفَاخَرْتَ (tafāḵarta) /ta.faː.xar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
# تَفَاخَرْتِ (tafāḵarti) /ta.faː.xar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاخَرَ (tafāḵara)
# تَفَاخَرَتْ (tafāḵarat) /ta.faː.xa.rat/: third-person fem
